blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY—A roll-on/roll-off (RoRo) vessel that ran aground off Barangay Udalo in Abra de Ilog, Occidental Mindoro, was refloated early Friday (Sept. 18), local emergency responders said. Then, the boat was brought safely to the Abra de Ilog Port. M/V Roromaster 5 was successfully refloated at about 1:30 a.m. on Sept. 18, aided by the rising tide and the vessel’s own engine, according to the Abra de Ilog Emergency Response Operations (AERO).
